lines.trans: Wooden laundry clothespins, Chen?! We're hosting an anniversary tea, not hanging bedsheets!
Hold on a second, Zhou—look how smooth and clean this natural birch wood is!
Watch what happens when I write Number One in dark carpenter pencil along the flat side.
Pencil writing on bare wood never smudges in water, and it clips tightly onto a folded cloth napkin!
Wait a moment... table number on one side, guest name on the other side, clipped to thick linen?!
And everyone can clip their wooden clothespin onto a saucer rim or pocket as a keepsake!
Chen, Qing—this idea is charming, rustic, windproof, and doesn't cost a single extra cent!
Besides, I also have a complete backup list copied neatly on page forty of my ledger.
Read the names out in order, Zhou, while I write out clothespins one through twenty-eight!
Pin Number One: our honored mapmaker from Room Eight! Pin Number Two: Song!
Look how briskly Qing writes—half the street's names are already lined up in neat wooden rows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí xià. Placed after an action verb to make a request or suggestion sound casual and brief (看一下, 等一下).

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 我来跟您请示一下，能不能要一份您的工作日程啊？
examples.trans: I came to ask if I might get a copy of your work schedule.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 你是我的粉丝会会长，你想见我一面并不难啊，这是何必呢？
examples.trans: You are president of my fan club — meeting me wasn't hard in the first place, so why go to such lengths?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个下午 ('an afternoon').

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Standard negation for present/future/habitual verbs and adjectives; shifts to bú before a 4th tone (不是 bú shì).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bú shì. In 不是……吗？, forms a rhetorical question ('didn't you...? / isn't it...?'); bù shifts to bú before 4th-tone shì.

examples.text: 你不是说今天下午要去集市吗？
examples.trans: Didn't you say you were going to the market this afternoon?

examples.text: 那把钥匙不是一直放在抽屉里吗？
examples.trans: Hasn't that key been in the drawer all along?

examples.text: 你也不用太悲观了，可以试试云海卫视。
examples.trans: You do not need to be too pessimistic either; you can try Yunhai Television.

examples.text: 外面雨已经停了，出门不用带伞。
examples.trans: The rain outside has already stopped, so there is no need to bring an umbrella.

meanings.note: Noun zhǔyi ('idea, plan').

examples.text: 他们商量出一个好主意。
examples.trans: They talked over a good plan.

examples.text: 你有什么好主意？
examples.trans: Do you have any good ideas?

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr. Used in counting, ordinals (第二), room numbers, and multi-digit numbers (二十); use 两 before measure words.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr shí bā. Cardinal number 二十 ('twenty') + 八 ('eight'); becomes ordinal with 第 (第二十八 'twenty-eighth').

examples.text: 这首曲子的第二十八小节非常温柔。
examples.trans: The twenty-eighth bar of this piece is very gentle.

examples.text: 二月通常只有二十八天。
examples.trans: February usually has only twenty-eight days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yà má. Combines 亚 ('flax/linseed') + 麻 ('hemp/plant fiber'); used for natural woven linen cloth (亚麻桌布 'linen tablecloth').

examples.text: 四块白亚麻桌布都已经熨得平平整整了。
examples.trans: All four white linen tablecloths have already been ironed nice and flat.

examples.text: 夏天铺上透气的亚麻桌布，整个阳光房都显得格外清爽。
examples.trans: With breathable linen tablecloths laid out in summer, the whole sunroom looks extra fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rén. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个人 ('a person').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huì. Expresses either an acquired skill (会弹钢琴) or likelihood in the future (会下雨).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhù. Means 'reside/stay overnight' as a main verb, or 'firmly in place' as a result complement (记住, 拿住).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Appears in compounds and verb-complement pairs like 装作 ('pretend to be').

examples.text: 而且大哥想装作镇定的时候，绝对不会早到。
examples.trans: Besides, when older brothers want to act calm, they never arrive early.

examples.text: 他装作什么都不知道。
examples.trans: He pretended not to know anything at all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Everyday verb for preparing food, doing work, or making objects.

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 小晴买了海盐黄油，今天我们做嫩炒蛋！
examples.trans: Qing bought sea-salt butter, so today we are making soft scrambled eggs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng huá. Combines 光 ('polished/sleek') + 滑 ('smooth'); often paired in 又光滑又柔软 ('both smooth and supple').

examples.text: 揉好的面团表面又光滑又柔软，按下去马上弹回来。
examples.trans: The kneaded dough is both smooth and supple on the surface, springing right back when pressed.

examples.text: 打磨过的核桃木桌面摸起来非常光滑。
examples.trans: The sanded walnut tabletop feels wonderfully smooth to the touch.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bā. Cardinal number 8.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. Marks a next step in sequence (先提再推) or a future repetition (再见 'see you again').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Conjunction/verb zàishuō ('besides; talk later').

examples.text: 再说了，还是跟着淳于总最好。
examples.trans: Besides, working under Chun Yuqiao is still best.

examples.text: 这件事等明天开完会再说吧。
examples.trans: Let us talk about this after tomorrow's meeting.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě. Used for writing characters, notes, letters, or reviews.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū qù. Directional compound moving from inside to outside.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 雨停了，我们出去走走吧。
examples.trans: The rain has stopped—let's go outside for a walk.

related.gloss: come fresh out of the oven

meanings.note: Pinyin: chū lái. Directional complement for coming out or figuring something out (认出来).

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

examples.text: 看合页边露出来的折纸图纸——一楼画着一扇暗门！
examples.trans: Look at the folded blueprint sticking out of the hinge—a hidden door is drawn on the ground floor!

related.gloss: come fresh out of the oven

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēn. Counts clock minutes (五分), test/review points (十分), and currency cents.

examples.text: 十、十一、十二。一分不差，谢谢！
examples.trans: Ten, eleven, twelve. Exact to the last cent—thank you!

examples.text: 我手表七点二十九分。客人下楼了。
examples.trans: Seven twenty-nine on my watch. Guests are coming down the stairs.

列.gloss: measure word for trains and rows

meanings.en: measure word for trains and rows
meanings.note: Pinyin: liè. Counts multi-car trains and lined-up series (一列火车 'a train').

examples.text: 五分钟演讲稿，列了十九条理由解释那年春天我们都错了。
examples.trans: A five-minute speech listing nineteen reasons why we were both wrong that spring.

examples.text: 下一列火车八点到站。
examples.trans: The next train arrives at the station at eight o'clock.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那我也不能不管吧，这怎么办啊？
examples.trans: Well, I cannot just ignore it either — what should I do?

examples.text: 把这件事交给他去办，你完全可以放心。
examples.trans: Leave this matter to him to handle — you can rest completely assured.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí. Cardinal number 10; building block for 11–99.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn. Follows a measure word for 'and a half' (七点半 '7:30') or precedes a measure word for 'half a' (半个小时).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu. Describes thick coats, walls, books, or blankets.

examples.text: 我床上有厚被子，今晚睡着很舒服。
examples.trans: I have a thick quilt on my bed, so sleeping tonight is very comfortable.

examples.text: 我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
examples.trans: I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?

meanings.en: raw, unpainted natural wood; timber log
meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán mù. Pairs 原 (original, unvarnished) with 木 (wood) to emphasize natural grain without paint or lacquer.

examples.text: 原木上的铅笔字碰水绝对不晕，还能牢牢夹住折好的布餐巾！
examples.trans: Pencil writing on bare wood never smudges in water, and it clips tightly onto a folded cloth napkin!

examples.text: 阳台栏杆保留了原木纹理，摸起来温润又结实。
examples.trans: The balcony railing kept its natural wood grain, feeling smooth and solid to the touch.

meanings.en: original undyed color of a material; primary color
meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán sè. Used in crafts and design for natural, unstained shades such as 原色桦木 (natural birch).

examples.text: 周经理，等一下——你看这原色桦木做得多光滑、多干净！
examples.trans: Hold on a second, Zhou—look how smooth and clean this natural birch wood is!

examples.text: 小晴挑了原色亚麻桌布，好衬出金灯笼的暖光。
examples.trans: Qing chose natural undyed linen tablecloths to set off the warm glow of the gold lanterns.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Marks an action repeating, or pairs two qualities in 又A又B ('both A and B').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǒu dài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个口袋 ('a pocket').

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

meanings.note: Determiner lìng ('other, another').

examples.text: 另一个人说必须先私下向他道歉。
examples.trans: The other person insists on a private apology first.

examples.text: 我们还需要另外准备一套方案。
examples.trans: We need to prepare another backup plan.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng dān. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份名单 ('a guest list').

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 今天的住店客人名单在电脑里。
examples.trans: Today's guest list is on the computer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个名字 ('a name').

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōunián. Measure word: 个.

examples.text: 今天是他们结婚十周年纪念日。
examples.trans: Today is their tenth wedding anniversary.

examples.text: 公司举行了成立周年的庆祝活动。
examples.trans: The company held a celebration for its anniversary.

meanings.en: we; us; our (inclusive of both the speaker and the listener)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zánmen. Unlike 我们 (which can exclude the listener), 咱们 specifically includes the person spoken to, creating a warm, collegial, or colloquial tone. Directly modifies nouns without 的 in set expressions like 咱们这行.

examples.text: 干咱们这行，谁不想跟他学习？
examples.trans: In our line of work, who wouldn't want to learn from him?

examples.text: 淳于总已经批准咱们的方案了。
examples.trans: Director Chun Yu has already approved our proposal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.en: cartographer; specialist who surveys and draws maps
meanings.note: Pinyin: dì tú shī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi). Combines 地图 (map) with 师 (master practitioner).

examples.text: 树下的第一桌安排了八号房的老地图师、宋老师，还有十号！
examples.trans: Table One under the tree is set for our Room Eight mapmaker, Song, and number ten!

examples.text: 一号夹：八号房的尊贵老地图师！二号夹：宋老师！
examples.trans: Pin Number One: our honored mapmaker from Room Eight! Pin Number Two: Song!

meanings.en: backup copy kept in case the original is lost or damaged
meanings.note: Pinyin: bèi fèn. Works both as a noun (备份名单, backup list) and as a verb ('to back up').

examples.text: 再说，我账本第四十页上还工工整整抄了一份完整备份名单呢。
examples.trans: Besides, I also have a complete backup list copied neatly on page forty of my ledger.

examples.text: 幸亏老陈留了纸面备份，不然大家差点儿记不清第十桌坐谁。
examples.trans: Thank goodness Chen kept a paper backup, or everyone might have forgotten who sat at table ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duō. Means 'many' as an adjective, 'how…?' before adjectives (多大), or 'more than' after round numbers (三十多).

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā. First-tone jiā: hold something pinched between two surfaces, such as under one's arm (夹在胳膊底下) or inside book pages.

examples.text: 周经理把绿色登记本夹在胳膊底下走来走去。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou paced back and forth with the green guest book tucked under his arm.

examples.text: 她在旧书里夹了一片干树叶做书签。
examples.trans: She tucked a dried leaf inside the old book as a bookmark.

meanings.note: polite, crisp affirmative reply

examples.text: 好的，王老师。
examples.trans: Alright, Teacher Wang.

examples.text: 我们等你，好的，谢谢！
examples.trans: We will wait for you — alright, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个字 ('a written character').

examples.text: 真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
examples.trans: How curious! The handwriting on that tag looked very familiar.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán zhěng. Describes something with no part missing or broken (又干净又完整 'clean and whole').

examples.text: 小晴，你看这些白琴键，又干净又完整。
examples.trans: Qing, look at these white keys—clean and whole.

examples.text: 这张老地图还很完整。
examples.trans: This old map is still complete.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kè rén. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位客人 ('a guest').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

meanings.en: honored; distinguished; worthy of high respect
meanings.note: Pinyin: zūn guì. Formal compliment used for esteemed elders, honored guests, or distinguished visitors.

examples.text: 一号夹：八号房的尊贵老地图师！二号夹：宋老师！
examples.trans: Pin Number One: our honored mapmaker from Room Eight! Pin Number Two: Song!

examples.text: 你说早班车？！那咱们尊贵的老地图师今天几点到呀？！
examples.trans: Did you say the early train?! Then what time is our honored mapmaker arriving today?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo qíng. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's new receptionist.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a adv used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个工工整整。
examples.trans: I have a 工工整整.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的工工整整。
examples.trans: This is a very good 工工整整.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ jīng. Often pairs with sentence-final 了 (已经到了 'has already arrived').

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经放进去了。
examples.trans: My dough is already in the oven, at least.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块布 ('a piece of cloth').

examples.text: 周经理，给您干净布和冷水。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, here is a clean cloth and cold water for you.

examples.text: 请拿一块干净的布擦桌子。
examples.trans: Please take a clean cloth to wipe the table.

related.gloss: a piece of cloth (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān jìng. Note first tone gān ('dry/clean'), never fourth tone.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng. Used as a stative adjective ('flat/level') or resultative complement after verbs (收平 'fold flat', 铺平 'smooth flat').

examples.text: 把折叠椅收平以后，就能靠墙放好了。
examples.trans: Once you fold the chair flat, you can lean it neatly against the wall.

examples.text: 院子中间的石板路铺得很平。
examples.trans: The flagstone path in the middle of the courtyard is laid very flat.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuáng dān. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张床单 ('a bedsheet').

examples.text: 我去柜子拿干净的白床单！
examples.trans: I will fetch clean white bedsheets from the cupboard!

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēi fēng. Combines 微 ('gentle/slight') + 风 ('wind/breeze'); measure word: 阵 (zhèn) or 缕 (lǚ).

examples.text: 窗户全都大敞开了，下午温暖的微风轻轻吹进九号房。
examples.trans: All the windows are wide open, and the warm afternoon breeze blows gently into Room Nine.

examples.text: 傍晚的微风吹过院子，带来了柠檬挞和薄荷茶的清香。
examples.trans: The evening breeze blew across the courtyard, carrying the fresh scent of lemon tarts and mint tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: niàn. Used for reading a letter or notice out loud (念第一行 'read the first line aloud').

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

examples.text: 十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

meanings.note: Interrogative zěnyàng ('how; what would happen').

examples.text: 这样的消息传出去会怎样？
examples.trans: What happens if news like this gets out?

examples.text: 你最近工作得怎样？
examples.trans: How has your work been going lately?

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng. Frequently serves as a result complement meaning 'into' (变成, 改成).

examples.text: 商业办公楼出售？！把我们的客栈和厨房变成灰色办公室？！
examples.trans: Commercial office sale?! Turn our inn and kitchen into grey offices?!

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.en: or (concise written and spoken alternative between items)
meanings.note: Pinyin: huò. Compact form of 或者 (huò zhě), linking nouns or short phrases cleanly.

examples.text: 而且每人都能把自己的木衣夹夹在茶碟边或口袋上留作纪念！
examples.trans: And everyone can clip their wooden clothespin onto a saucer rim or pocket as a keepsake!

examples.text: 茶会点心可以配热薄荷茶或冰凉乌龙茶，随客人喜欢。
examples.trans: Tea-party pastries pair nicely with hot mint tea or chilled oolong, whichever guests prefer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a verb used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个抄。
examples.trans: I have a 抄.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的抄。
examples.trans: This is a very good 抄.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhé. Used for folding chairs, blueprints, or paper.

examples.text: 等等，换房间我们给他打多少折？
examples.trans: Wait—what discount do we offer him for changing rooms?

examples.text: 快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
examples.trans: Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: àn. Used for pressing a doorbell, elevator button, or key (按门铃).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pái. Counts rows of keys, seats, or houses (一排钥匙 'a row of keys').

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

examples.text: 墙上整整齐齐挂着一排钥匙。
examples.trans: A neat row of keys hangs on the wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng qí. Describes neatly arranged keys, chairs, or handwriting.

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

meanings.note: Correlative conjunction jì ('both ... and ...').

examples.text: 这样做既能体现价值，又很务实。
examples.trans: Doing this both reflects values and stays practical.

examples.text: 这位主持人既幽默又专业。
examples.trans: This host is both witty and professional.

meanings.note: Friendly workplace farewell míngtiān jiàn.

examples.text: 我先走了，明天见！
examples.trans: I am heading off, see you tomorrow!

examples.text: 大家辛苦了，明天见！
examples.trans: Great work everyone, see you tomorrow!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.en: to blur or bleed outward when liquid touches ink or dye
meanings.note: Pinyin: yùn. Fourth-tone reading (yùn, not first-tone yūn 'dizzy') specifically means ink spreading or smudging on paper.

examples.text: 你看第三桌——梧桐巷的街坊全晕成一只大蓝水母了！
examples.trans: Look at Table Three—everyone on Wutong Lane has bled together into one giant blue jellyfish!

examples.text: 原木上的铅笔字碰水绝对不晕，还能牢牢夹住折好的布餐巾！
examples.trans: Pencil writing on bare wood never smudges in water, and it clips tightly onto a folded cloth napkin!

晾.gloss: to hang out to dry; air out

meanings.en: to hang laundry or spread items in fresh air to dry or cool
meanings.note: Pinyin: liàng. Everyday household verb used both for hanging sheets (晾床单) and cooling baked goods.

examples.text: 老陈，木头晾衣夹？！咱们是办周年茶会，又不是晾床单！
examples.trans: Wooden laundry clothespins, Chen?! We're hosting an anniversary tea, not hanging bedsheets!

examples.text: 刚洗净的亚麻餐巾在后院晒了一上午，现在都晾干收好了。
examples.trans: The freshly washed linen napkins aired out in the back yard all morning and are now dry and folded.

meanings.en: wooden or plastic clothespin used to clip laundry onto a line
meanings.note: Pinyin: liàng yī jiā. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī). Also shortened to 衣夹 (yī jiā).

examples.text: 老陈，木头晾衣夹？！咱们是办周年茶会，又不是晾床单！
examples.trans: Wooden laundry clothespins, Chen?! We're hosting an anniversary tea, not hanging bedsheets!

examples.text: 谁也没想到，几分钱一个的桦木晾衣夹竟成了茶会上最受欢迎的纪念品。
examples.trans: Nobody guessed that simple birch clothespins would turn into the most popular keepsakes at the tea party.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木头 ('a piece of wood').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

related.gloss: a piece of wood (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木头 ('a piece of wood').

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

related.gloss: a piece of wood (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù gōng. Combines 木 ('wood') + 工 ('craft/artisan'); modifies tools and materials like 木工胶水 ('woodworking glue').

examples.text: 老陈的工具箱里常备着细砂纸和木工胶水。
examples.trans: Chen's toolbox always keeps fine sandpaper and woodworking glue on hand.

examples.text: 这把结实的圆木椅是一位老木工亲手做的。
examples.trans: This sturdy wooden chair was handmade by a veteran carpenter.

条.gloss: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses

meanings.en: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses
meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo. Counts long, narrow, or winding things: streets, rivers, scarves, towels, trousers, and legal clauses (一条街).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuō. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张桌子 ('a table').

examples.text: 等等——小美这会儿正要把蛋糕端到他们那桌去。
examples.trans: Wait—Mei is taking the cake out to their table right now.

examples.text: 从明天早上八点开始！屋里四张桌，树下三张桌！
examples.trans: Starting tomorrow morning at eight! Four tables indoors, three tables under the tree!

meanings.en: birch timber; pale fine-grained birch wood
meanings.note: Pinyin: huà mù. Prized for smooth, splinter-free wooden clothespins, dowels, and small craft items.

examples.text: 周经理，等一下——你看这原色桦木做得多光滑、多干净！
examples.trans: Hold on a second, Zhou—look how smooth and clean this natural birch wood is!

examples.text: 再低头看餐桌：二十八条亚麻餐巾全被编好号的桦木夹咬得死死的！
examples.trans: And look down at the tables: all twenty-eight linen napkins are clamped tight by numbered birch pins!

检验.gloss: to test; inspect; put to the proof

meanings.en: to inspect, examine, or test reliability in practice
meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎn yàn. Combines 检 (check) with 验 (verify by test), used both formally in workshops and playfully in daily banter.

examples.text: 端着这篮子出去，让下午的微风检验一下咱们的防风餐桌吧！
examples.trans: Carry this basket outside and let the afternoon breeze test out our windproof tables!

examples.text: 小美先切一小块温蛋糕尝尝，检验蜂蜜糖釉甜度正不正好。
examples.trans: Mei cut a tiny slice of warm cake first to test whether the honey glaze sweetness was just right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi. Usually followed by a measure word (每个星期 'every week', 每位客人 'every guest').

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯水 ('a glass of water').

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

examples.text: 摸摸热水管——下面是温的，上面变凉了。
examples.trans: Feel the hot-water pipe—the bottom is warm, while the top is turning cool.

related.gloss: a glass of water (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēn sè. Built from 深 ('deep') + 色 ('color'); opposite of 浅色 ('light-colored').

examples.text: 一，二……哇！看这深色的亮木头！
examples.trans: One, two... wow! Look at this dark, shiny wood!

examples.text: 他喜欢穿深色的衣服。
examples.trans: He likes wearing dark clothes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: láo láo. Reduplicated adverb placed directly before verbs like 夹住 ('clamp') or 记住 ('remember').

examples.text: 原木上的铅笔字碰水绝对不晕，还能牢牢夹住折好的布餐巾！
examples.trans: Pencil writing on bare wood never smudges in water, and it clips tightly onto a folded cloth napkin!

examples.text: 老陈把木梯底部牢牢抵在石阶上，才放心让小晴往上挂灯笼。
examples.trans: Chen braced the foot of the wooden ladder firmly against the stone step before letting Qing climb up with the lanterns.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú. Used for leaving a note/keepsake, saving food, or staying on (留下来).

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pèng. Used for touching objects or running into someone (碰到 'bump into').

examples.text: 拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
examples.trans: Careful on the turn—do not bump the wall!

examples.text: 我在街口正好碰到了老邻居。
examples.trans: I happened to run into an old neighbor at the corner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duān. Specifically describes carrying dishes, soup, or tea level in the hands.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 她端着一盘热面包走出来。
examples.trans: She walked out carrying a tray of warm bread.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì sì. Ordinal number formed with prefix 第 (dì) + 四 ('four').

examples.text: 小美，第四盘柠檬挞还剩几块？
examples.trans: How many slices of lemon tart are left on the fourth tray, Mei?

examples.text: 顺着梧桐巷往前走，第四家店就是老先生的提琴工坊。
examples.trans: Walk down Wutong Lane and the fourth shop is the older gentleman's violin workshop.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng. Everyday verb for waiting (等一下 'wait a moment').

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lán zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个篮子 ('a basket').

examples.text: 篮子里正躺着六个黄柠檬呢——厨房就等今天了！
examples.trans: Six yellow lemons are sitting in my basket right now—this kitchen was waiting for today!

examples.text: 竹篮子里装着刚烤好的热面包卷。
examples.trans: Freshly baked warm bread rolls sit inside the bamboo basket.

meanings.en: to commemorate or mark an occasion; a memento or keepsake (as in 留作纪念)
meanings.note: Pinyin: jì niàn. Often heard in 做个纪念 ('keep as a souvenir').

examples.text: 而且每人都能把自己的木衣夹夹在茶碟边或口袋上留作纪念！
examples.trans: And everyone can clip their wooden clothespin onto a saucer rim or pocket as a keepsake!

examples.text: 大家都在衣夹背面签了名，准备放进新铁盒里留作三十年的纪念。
examples.trans: Everyone signed the back of the clothespin to place it in the new tin box as a thirty-year keepsake.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jué duì. Strong emphatic adverb.

examples.text: 而且大哥想装作镇定的时候，绝对不会早到。
examples.trans: Besides, when older brothers want to act calm, they never arrive early.

examples.text: 用咸黄油炒出来的鸡蛋绝对香！
examples.trans: Scrambled eggs made with salted butter are guaranteed to smell amazing!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo chén. Affectionate respectful name for Courtyard Inn's handyman.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 谢谢老陈。里面的木头小火车看着很珍贵。
examples.trans: Thank you, Chen. The little wooden train inside looked very precious.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ér qiě. Adds a further supporting point.

examples.text: 而且他今晚八点到这里——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening—in forty minutes!

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: néng. Expresses practical ability or whether circumstances allow something (能睡个好觉).

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì jǐ. Follows pronouns to stress 'by oneself' (你自己 'you yourself').

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

meanings.note: Verb/noun huā ('spend time/money').

examples.text: 我花了六年的时间学习电视节目制作。
examples.trans: I spent six full years studying TV production.

examples.text: 这笔宣传预算必须花在刀刃上。
examples.trans: This publicity budget must be spent where it counts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯茶 ('a cup of tea').

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

related.gloss: a cup of tea (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá dié. Compound 茶 ('tea') + 碟 ('small dish/saucer'). Measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 厚陶土茶杯放在配套的茶碟上，声音很轻。
examples.trans: When the thick stoneware teacup is set on its matching saucer, it makes a soft, quiet sound.

examples.text: 小晴擦干了十二个白茶碟，整整齐齐叠在柜子里。
examples.trans: Qing wiped the twelve white saucers dry and stacked them neatly in the cupboard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条街 ('a street').

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī jiā. Measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī), e.g. 二十八个桦木衣夹 ('twenty-eight birch clothespins').

examples.text: 走，下楼吧——前台还有三十个木衣夹等着小晴呢。
examples.trans: Come on downstairs—I have thirty wooden clothespins waiting for Qing at the front desk.

examples.text: 小晴把九号衣夹放进铁盒前，先让院子里的每个人都在背面签了名。
examples.trans: Before placing clothespin number nine into the tin box, Qing had everyone in the courtyard sign its back.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ràng. Everyday causative/polite-offer verb (让我看看 'let me have a look').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàng běn. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本账本 ('an account ledger').

examples.text: 说得对。公事等一等——先放在账本旁边。
examples.trans: Right you are. Paperwork can wait—set it beside the ledger for now.

examples.text: 每天关门以前，经理都会核对一遍账本。
examples.trans: Before closing up each night, the manager checks the ledger.

meanings.en: simple, rustic, and unpretentious; honest and unadorned
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì pǔ. Warm praise for natural materials, manners, or writing.

examples.text: 老陈、小晴——这主意既雅致质朴又防风，而且一分钱都不用多花！
examples.trans: Chen, Qing—this idea is charming, rustic, windproof, and doesn't cost a single extra cent!

examples.text: 几根原木衣夹配白布餐巾，看着质朴又亲切，大家都喜欢。
examples.trans: Bare wooden clothespins paired with white linen napkins looked rustic and welcoming, winning everyone over.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一边 ('one side').

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

examples.text: 快坐在向阳窗户边，宋老师！先别急着上楼！
examples.trans: Sit right down by the sunny window, Teacher Song! No rush to go back upstairs yet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 笔 (bǐ), e.g. 一笔钱 ('a sum of money').

examples.text: 怎么样？他发火了吗？要退钱吗？
examples.trans: How did it go? Did he lose his temper? Did he ask for a refund?

examples.text: 买黄油和牛奶一共花了十二块钱。
examples.trans: Buying butter and milk cost twelve yuan altogether.

related.gloss: a sum of money (measure word 笔)

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān bǐ. Measure word (量词): 支, e.g. 一支铅笔 ('a pencil').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

meanings.note: Pinyin: duì. Measure word (量词): 支 (zhī) or 排 (pái). Also a classifier itself (一队人 'a line of people').

examples.text: 小晴和老陈组成了一队，参加客栈的寻宝游戏。
examples.trans: Qing and Chen formed a team to participate in the inn's treasure hunt game.

examples.text: 孩子们排成整齐的一队，跟着老师走进了博物馆。
examples.trans: The children lined up in a neat row and followed the teacher into the museum.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng fēng. Pairs 防 ('guard against') + 风 ('wind').

examples.text: 先救灯笼，再解决防风座位——有我在，谁都别慌。
examples.trans: Rescue the lanterns first, solve the windproof seats second—with me here, nobody panic.

examples.text: 用桦木衣夹把餐巾夹好以后，整张院子餐桌立刻变得既防风又整齐。
examples.trans: Once the napkins were clipped with birch clothespins, every courtyard table looked windproof and neat.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎ zhì. Praises courtyard decor, table settings, or modest good taste.

examples.text: 老陈、小晴——这主意既雅致质朴又防风，而且一分钱都不用多花！
examples.trans: Chen, Qing—this idea is charming, rustic, windproof, and doesn't cost a single extra cent!

examples.text: 九号阳光房收拾得简洁雅致，一走进去就让人心情平静。
examples.trans: Room Nine's sunroom is arranged so simply and tastefully that stepping inside calms the mind right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yè. Counts pages directly without 个 (第二页 'page two').

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
examples.trans: Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!

meanings.note: Arrangement of items one after another.

examples.text: 请按照单子上的先后顺序逐一核对准备工作。
examples.trans: Please check off preparations in the exact sequence on the sheet.

examples.text: 歌手明晚出场的顺序将由现场抽签决定。
examples.trans: The order singers perform tomorrow night will be drawn by lot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cān jīn. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张餐巾 ('a napkin').

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cān zhuō. Measure word: 张 (zhāng), e.g. 四张圆餐桌 ('four round dining tables').

examples.text: 端着这篮子出去，让下午的微风检验一下咱们的防风餐桌吧！
examples.trans: Carry this basket outside and let the afternoon breeze test out our windproof tables!

examples.text: 一号餐桌摆在老树阴凉底下，上面已经放好了温热的茶盘。
examples.trans: Table one stands in the cool shade of the old tree, already set with warm tea trays.

meanings.en: quick, nimble, and efficient in one's movements
meanings.note: Pinyin: má lì. Warm everyday praise for tidy, fast hands at work.

examples.text: 看小晴写得多麻利——半条街的名字都已经排成整齐的木夹队列了。
examples.trans: Look how briskly Qing writes—half the street's names are already lined up in neat wooden rows.

examples.text: 志鹏收拾茶盘手脚真麻利，没三分钟就把桌面擦得干干净净。
examples.trans: Peng is remarkably nimble clearing tea trays—within three minutes he wiped every tabletop spotless.
